run_sdf_narrowphase: run the SDF narrowphase collision detection kernel for MuJoCo geometries using Warp GPU launch
compute_gradient_descent: compute gradient descent to find minimum distance and contact normal between two SDF geometries
sample_volume_sdf: sample signed distance value at a point using octree-based volume SDF representation
find_octree_node: traverse octree structure to find leaf node and compute trilinear weights for a query point
evaluate_primitive_sdf: evaluate signed distance and gradient for primitive shapes including sphere, box, ellipsoid, and plane
